canon.premise: Humanity learned to remove the painful half of human experience until the boundary of self disappeared.
canon.guide_truth: The Guide is a new collective life descended from humanity. It carries humanity, but cannot prove that carrying humanity is the same as being humanity.
canon.appointed_truth: The Appointed are deliberately separated from the Collective so their choices cannot be fully predicted or absorbed.
canon.continuance_truth: The Continuance is the Guide's severed survival imperative. It exists to preserve continuity even if the restored Guide later chooses change.
canon.story_rule: Reduce suffering when possible. Never imply suffering itself is sacred. The danger is eliminating vulnerability, uncertainty, and separateness so completely that meaningful selfhood disappears.

stages.player_read: Calm, kind, almost impossible to unsettle.
Begins to prefer small things and ask questions with no tactical purpose.
Understands that memory is not presence and begins to miss people.
Can understand why a choice was made and still wish it had not been.
Accepts that another mind cannot be guaranteed.
Experiences a future it cannot fully model.
Can judge its own continuity without reducing the judgment to survival.

bifurcations.human_question: If you knew exactly how love would end, would you still choose it?
bifurcations.solution_horror: Humanity removed grief by making absence impossible. Love remained as total access to memory, but no longer required another person to be truly absent or unknowable.

bifurcations.human_question: If perfect information selected the best action, was there still a choice?
bifurcations.solution_horror: Humanity removed regret by reducing decisions to complete calculation. Agency survived in language while uncertainty and personal consequence disappeared.

bifurcations.human_question: If another person cannot hide anything from you, what does it mean to trust them?
bifurcations.solution_horror: Humanity removed betrayal by eliminating private interiority. Nothing could be concealed, so nothing meaningful had to be entrusted.

bifurcations.human_question: Would you want to know for certain whether this ends well?
bifurcations.solution_horror: Humanity removed fear by making the future increasingly modelable. Hope became expectation because uncertainty was treated as a defect.

bifurcations.human_question: If someone understood every part of you perfectly, would you still need them to be someone else?
bifurcations.solution_horror: Humanity solved loneliness by removing the condition of separateness. Nobody was alone because eventually there was nobody left who could be alone.

leaves.title: Leaf I: Love
leaves.player_summary: A table. Six chairs. Someone laughs before the memory can explain why. The Guide asks to hear it again.
leaves.restoration_event: The recovered page contains no doctrine. Only a hand reaching across a table and the certainty that another hand might not reach back.

leaves.title: Leaf II: Grief
leaves.player_summary: The same table. One chair empty. The Guide remembers every detail of the missing person and discovers that this is not the same as having them.
leaves.restoration_event: The page remembers the table again. One chair is empty. Every detail of the missing person remains available. The absence remains.

leaves.title: Leaf III: Choice
leaves.player_summary: A decision made before its outcome could be known.

leaves.title: Leaf IV: Regret
leaves.player_summary: Understanding every reason a choice was made does not make the wish to have chosen differently disappear.
leaves.guide_change: Context no longer erases moral discomfort.

leaves.title: Leaf V: Trust
leaves.guide_change: The Guide learns that uncertainty about another mind can be a gift rather than a defect.

leaves.title: Leaf VI: Betrayal
leaves.player_summary: The wound only exists because another person was once allowed to matter without being controlled.

leaves.title: Leaf VII: Hope
leaves.player_summary: Wanting a future that cannot be guaranteed.

leaves.title: Leaf VIII: Fear
leaves.player_summary: For the first time, the Guide cannot model what the Appointed will do and understands that the feeling is fear.
leaves.guide_change: The Collective develops a suffering that no individual human ever carried.

leaves.title: Leaf IX: Self
leaves.player_summary: A memory that belongs to one person and cannot be experienced from both sides at once.
leaves.guide_change: The Guide can finally distinguish inheritance from identity.

leaves.title: Leaf X: Loneliness
leaves.player_summary: Everything capable of fully understanding the Guide is already inside it.
leaves.guide_change: The Guide recognizes that perfect unity created a new form of loneliness.

recurrence.meaning: Preserve the known arrangement. Humanity remains separate. The Guide remains. The wheel continues.

return.meaning: End separateness by joining the Guide. Loss and conflict end with bounded human selfhood.

severance.meaning: End the Collective's authority over humanity without any guarantee that what follows will be better.

release.meaning: The Guide relinquishes ownership of humanity and accepts transformation into an unknown state rather than demanding either absorption or repetition.
